t: A music lesson where students program an Ozobot to play a familiar song.
steps: Find the Ozobot Karaoke lesson on the ASU STEM Teachers site.
Open the Google Slides lesson plan.
Prepare student devices with access to OzoBlockly.
Have students finish a basic OzoBlockly lesson first.
Choose songs and review the choices for fit.
Share only note images with students as the slides suggest.
